metadata.description: Read-only Prisma SASE (Prisma Access) AI-assistant tools: MCP server + ops Skill. One code tree, three OS-specific catalog entries — install the one matching your OS.

plugins.name: prisma-sase-mac
plugins.description: Prisma SASE read-only tools + ops Skill — macOS variant (launches via bash). Windows: prisma-sase-windows; Linux: prisma-sase-linux.

client_id.title: Prisma SASE Client ID
client_id.description: Service-account Client ID, e.g. apikey@1234567890.iam.panserviceaccount.com (see the README's API-key walkthrough)

client_secret.title: Prisma SASE Client Secret
client_secret.description: Shown only once when the service account is created. Stored in secure storage (macOS Keychain, or ~/.claude/.credentials.json where no keychain is available), never in settings.json. This is the recommended path; leave empty only if you supply the secret another way (~/.prisma-sase.env or PRISMA_SECRET_CMD).

tsg_id.title: TSG ID
tsg_id.description: Tenant Service Group ID -- the digits after @ in the Client ID

region.title: Region
region.description: X-PANW-Region header value for your tenant, e.g. sg, us, de
